invariance: What you may change without moving the answer.
round-trip: Out to text and back loses nothing. Text read in and written out again comes back in its normal form.
refinement: What a reader without every payload is still promised, and how it learns what it couldn't read.
order: Two different things never tie, and where a test answers, it and its opposite leave no gap.
exactness: Exactly where a law holds: both ways, one way, or refused with a reason it names.
